get_language with empty string returns an error

```rust title="Rust"
use tree_sitter_language_pack::get_language;

fn main() {
    let name = r#""#;
    let language = get_language(name);
    match language {
        Ok(value) => println!("{:?}", value),
        Err(error) => println!("{error}"),
    }
}
```
